out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at handwashing sink IN THE DISHWASHING MACHINE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC ADDED PAPER TOWELS TO THE HANDSINK DURING THE INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASHING SINKS ARE ALWAYS PROPERLY SUPPLIED WITH TOWELS.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at FRONT handwashing sink NEXT TO STEAM TABLE.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC ADDED SOAP DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE ALL HANDWASHING SINKS ARE ALWAYS PROPERLY SUPPLIED.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. NO CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER OBSERVED ONSITE AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS A CFM MUST BE ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: Observed dirty knife in knife rack. When asked to clean, the certified food manager rinsed and dried the knife and put it back without wash, rinsing and sanitizing.
violations.corrective_action: Corrected by sending to the dishmachine. All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. No backflow prevention device observed at ice tea brewer at front counter.
violations.corrective_action: Please obtain proper backflow prevention device and send a picture to the information provided within 72hrs. A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14.
